triggerRaw: 八年前，受远野家血统特有的反转冲动影响，四季发狂变成怪物袭击秋叶
processRaw: 志贵挺身而出，以自己的生命为代价替秋叶挡下致命一击
completionRaw: 胸口因此留下巨大伤疤，并陷入濒死；苏醒后遗忘真相并觉醒直死之魔眼
effectSummary: Shiki shields Akiha from a fatal attack by SHIKI, is left with a large chest scar and near-death state, then awakens Mystic Eyes after waking while forgetting the inversion impulse truth.
candidateReason: Akiha and SHIKI are direct backstory mentions only; this packet does not create standalone formal profiles for them.
